summary.text: Griff Griffitts represents District 6 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Republican, elected in 2022 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: Griffitts is a small business owner in Panama City Beach, where Griffitts lives, and was previously a county commissioner.
Griffitts was born in Panama City, Florida, and attended Florida State University from 1989 to 1993.
